description: List the tables and columns staged on a DataCanvas so you can write valid SQL for openaq_dataframe_query without guessing column names. Returns each measurement table (measurements_<sensorId>) with its row count and column names. Requires DataCanvas to be enabled.

canvas_id.description: DataCanvas id returned by openaq_get_measurements — minted when a series overflowed the inline preview, or the canvas_id you passed it.

name: openaq_dataframe_describe

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: DataCanvas is not enabled (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not duckdb). `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is unknown or its canvas has expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the canvas holds no tables yet.

tables.description: Tables currently staged on the canvas.

items.description: A staged measurement table with its columns

name.description: Table name — reference it in openaq_dataframe_query SQL.

title: openaq-mcp-server: dataframe describe
